Presenting the full video song " Paayaliya" from the Bollywood movie ' Dev D' featuring Abhay Deol, Kalki Koechlin, Mahi Gill, Parakh Madan. The song is sung by Shruti Pathak and the music is composed by Amit Trivedi. The lyrics are written by Shruti Pathak.
Song - Paayaliya
Film - Dev D
Singer - Shruti Pathak
Lyricist - Shruti Pathak
Music Director - Amit Trivedi
Artist - Abhay Deol, Kalki Koechlin, Mahi Gill, Parakh Madan
Music On - T-Series
